decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY captures the piston-end arrangement but omits the clarified sliding-motion path through the bushing.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: No. As stated in the message (it is shown incorrectly in the drawings), the bushing sits inside the main shaft, and the rod from the control piston is guided through this bushing. Therefore, you need to select a suitable clearance, such as H8/h9, between the bushing and the inner diameter of the shaft. The sliding part contains only the end of the piston.

value_updates.piston_end_arrangement: The sliding part contains only the end of the piston.
value_updates.sliding_motion_path: The control-piston rod runs inside the main shaft and is guided through the bushing to provide sliding movement.
